🎬 Preacher (2016–2019)

Preacher follows Jesse Custer, a troubled small-town preacher in Texas whose life changes dramatically when he becomes possessed by a mysterious supernatural force known as Genesis. This extraordinary power gives Jesse the ability to command almost anyone to obey his words, placing him at the center of a dangerous conflict involving angels, demons, religious organizations, and powerful enemies. Struggling with his violent past and complicated relationship with faith, Jesse sets out on an unpredictable journey to find God and demand answers about the mysterious forces controlling his life. Alongside him are Tulip O’Hare, his fearless and unpredictable former girlfriend, and Cassidy, a charismatic Irish vampire whose reckless personality frequently leads to hilarious and dangerous situations. Together, the unlikely trio travels through strange towns and dangerous territories, encountering ruthless assassins, supernatural creatures, bizarre religious figures, and shocking conspiracies. As their adventure becomes increasingly chaotic, Jesse must confront painful memories, difficult moral choices, and the consequences of his extraordinary abilities. Meanwhile, Tulip and Cassidy face their own personal struggles as their friendships and loyalties are tested. Combining outrageous dark humor, brutal action, supernatural mystery, and unpredictable storytelling, the series explores faith, redemption, friendship, power, morality, and the complicated search for meaning in a world filled with chaos.

🎭 Genre: Supernatural • Action • Drama • Dark Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 7.9/10

⏱️ Runtime: 42–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Developers: Sam Catlin, Seth Rogen & Evan Goldberg

📺 Where to Watch: Check AMC+, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Preacher is an American black comedy action horror television series developed by Sam Catlin, Evan Goldberg, and Seth Rogen for AMC starring Dominic Cooper, Joseph Gilgun and Ruth Negga. The series is based on the comic book series Preacher created by Garth Ennis and Steve Dillon and published by DC Comics' Vertigo imprint. The series premiered on May 22, 2016, and ran for four seasons, concluding on September 29, 2019.
